sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Check current state
seg = current_frame.segmentation

# Find key objects
char_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
green_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
yellow_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y']
pink_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
purple_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p']

print(f"Character: {char_nodes[0]['boundary'] if char_nodes else 'not found'}")
print(f"Green: {len(green_nodes)}, Yellow: {len(yellow_nodes)}, Pink: {len(pink_nodes)}, Purple: {len(purple_nodes)}")

# Look at purple nodes
for n in purple_nodes[:5]:
    print(f"  Purple: boundary={n['boundary']}, pixels={n['pixels']}")

# Try converting one green platform to see what happens
if green_nodes:
    n = green_nodes[0]
    rows = [p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
    cols = [p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
    center_row = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_col = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    print(f"\nConverting green at ({center_row}, {center_col})")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_row, 'col': center_col}])
    print(f"  level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}, done={last_action_result.get('done')}, gameplay_changed={last_action_result.get('gameplay_changed')}")
    
    # Check if level changed
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    green2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    pink2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'P']
    print(f"  Green remaining: {len(green2)}, Pink: {len(pink2)}")
    
    # Check if character moved
    char2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b']
    print(f"  Character: {char2[0]['boundary'] if char2 else 'not found'}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
